summary: IceCure Medical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 2, 2026, announcing a 1-for-30 reverse share split to regain compliance with Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid price requirement. The split was approved by shareholders on May 11, 2026, and will take effect at market open on June 4, 2026, with shares trading under the same symbol ICCM. The company has until November 9, 2026, to cure non-compliance. This is a routine capital market compliance action, not a special situation.
